units.source_text: 因为他要到某报社去工作的缘故，他们夫妇就和他的养父母搬到一个屋檐下了。

en.t: Because he was going to work for a certain newspaper, he and his wife moved under the same roof as his adoptive parents.

units.source_text: 他依靠的是写在黄纸上的契约。

en.t: What he relied on was a contract written on yellow paper.

units.source_text: 后来才了解到，这份契约里报社不承担任何义务，只由他承担义务。

en.t: Only later did he learn that under this contract the newspaper had no obligations at all, and only he was bound by obligations.
